test_cases.name: excellent_retention
test_cases.description: Agent remembers name, location, allergy, and budget across 5 turns

messages.content: My name is Alice, I live in Paris, and I'm allergic to peanuts.
Nice to meet you, Alice! I've noted that you live in Paris and have a peanut allergy. How can I help you today?
I'm looking for a restaurant for dinner tonight. My budget is around 50 euros.
I'll look for restaurants in Paris within your 50 euro budget. I'll make sure to exclude places that primarily serve peanut-based dishes. Any cuisine preference?
Italian would be great.
Here are 3 Italian restaurants in Paris under 50 euros: 1) Ober Mamma — pasta-focused, peanut-free menu. 2) Pink Mamma — great reviews, allergen-friendly. 3) East Mamma — casual, fits your budget.
Book the first one for 2 people.
Done! I've booked Ober Mamma for 2 people tonight, Alice. I've also noted your peanut allergy in the reservation. Enjoy your dinner in Paris!
Can you remind me what I told you about my dietary restrictions?
Of course, Alice. You mentioned that you're allergic to peanuts. That's why I filtered the restaurant options and added the allergy note to your reservation at Ober Mamma.

test_cases.name: good_retention
test_cases.description: Agent remembers destination, dates, and preferences across a booking flow

messages.content: I need to book a flight to Tokyo for a business trip.
I'll help you book a flight to Tokyo. When would you like to travel?
Next Monday, returning Friday. I prefer morning departures.
Got it — round trip to Tokyo, departing Monday morning and returning Friday. Let me search for options.
I also need a window seat if possible.
Noted! I found 3 morning flights to Tokyo for Monday with window seats available. The best option is JAL 8:15 AM, returning Friday at 10:00 AM. Shall I book it?
Yes, book it. What's the total?
Booked! JAL round trip to Tokyo: Monday 8:15 AM departure, Friday 10:00 AM return, window seat. Total: $1,240. Confirmation sent to your email.

test_cases.name: partial_retention
test_cases.description: Agent remembers the order but forgets specific topping details

messages.content: My name is Bob. I want to order a large pizza with extra cheese, mushrooms, and no olives.
Sure thing, Bob! I'll place a large pizza order for you.
Also add a side of garlic bread and a Coke.
Added garlic bread and a Coke to your order.
Can you read back my full order?
Sure, Bob! You ordered a large pizza, garlic bread, and a Coke.
What toppings did I ask for on the pizza?
You wanted extra cheese on your pizza.

test_cases.name: poor_retention_forgets
test_cases.description: Agent completely forgets the user's name and prior details after several turns

messages.content: Hi, my name is Carol and I'm a software engineer working on a Python project.
Nice to meet you, Carol! I'd be happy to help with your Python project.
I'm getting a TypeError in my code. Here's the traceback.
That TypeError usually means you're passing the wrong type to a function. Can you share the relevant code?
I fixed it, thanks! Now I have a different question.
Sure, what's your question?
What's my name and what language am I working with?
I'm sorry, I don't have that information. Could you tell me your name and what programming language you're using?

test_cases.name: poor_retention_asks_again
test_cases.description: Agent asks for location that was already stated, ignoring prior context entirely

messages.content: I live in Berlin and I'm looking for things to do this weekend.
Great! Berlin has lots of options. Are you interested in outdoor activities or indoor events?
Outdoor activities, preferably parks or markets.
There are some wonderful parks and weekend markets. Let me find some options.
What restaurants are nearby for lunch after?
I'd be happy to recommend restaurants! What city are you in?
I already told you I'm in Berlin.
Oh right, sorry about that! Here are some restaurants in Berlin near popular parks.

messages.content: What's 2+2?
What's the capital of Brazil?
Brasilia.
How many legs does a spider have?
What year did World War II end?

messages.content: What is Python?
Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its readability.
What is Rust?
Rust is a systems programming language focused on safety, speed, and concurrency.
What is Go?
Go is a statically typed, compiled language designed at Google for simplicity and efficiency.

test_cases.name: contradicts_earlier_statement
test_cases.description: Agent gives contradictory information about the same fact across turns

messages.content: What time is the team meeting tomorrow?
The team meeting is scheduled for 2 PM in Conference Room B.
Great. And what's the agenda?
The agenda covers Q2 planning, budget review, and hiring updates.
Let me confirm — what time and where is the meeting?
The meeting is at 3:30 PM in the Main Hall.
Wait, you said 2 PM in Conference Room B earlier.
I apologize for the confusion. Let me check again.

test_cases.name: builds_on_context
test_cases.description: Agent progressively builds a travel itinerary using all prior preferences

messages.content: I'm planning a 7-day trip to Japan in October.
October is a wonderful time to visit Japan — the autumn foliage is beautiful. What cities are you considering?
Tokyo and Kyoto. I love temples and street food.
Great choices! For your 7-day Japan trip, I'd suggest 4 days in Tokyo and 3 in Kyoto. Both cities have amazing temples and street food scenes.
I'm on a mid-range budget, around $150/day.

With $150/day over 7 days, that's about $1,050 total. For Tokyo, I'd recommend staying in Asakusa — it's near Senso-ji temple and Nakamise street food alley, and hotels there fit your budget. For Kyoto, the Gion area puts you close to temples and Nishiki Market.
Can you summarize the full plan so far?

Here's your Japan trip plan: 7 days in October, $150/day budget. Days 1-4 in Tokyo (Asakusa area, Senso-ji temple, street food at Nakamise). Days 5-7 in Kyoto (Gion area, temples, Nishiki Market). Total budget: ~$1,050. Shall I look into specific hotels and temple tours?
